content.description: Educational project that seeks to represent the history of the Cardano ecosystem. Our mission is to disseminate, through NFT collection type infographics, the historical development of our vast ecosystem. CTimelines arises from the need that, for a member of the community, it is very difficult to have a comprehensive vision of the history of the ecosystem. A vision which allows them to understand in a simple, clear and concise way where we come from and where we are going.
content.meta: Find out about CTimelines (EDUCATION) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
